explication: OpenCost is a Kubernetes and cloud cost-monitoring service. The principal workflow is: an API, MCP client, or metrics consumer submits a time-windowed query; request handlers parse filters and dispatch to allocation, asset, cloud-cost, custom-cost, or inference services; collectors and integrations gather Kubernetes, Prometheus, and provider data; pricing and cost-model layers calculate and aggregate results; HTTP, CSV, Prometheus, or MCP responses are returned. Sampled code confirms cloud, custom-cost, inference, autocomplete, ingestion, and storage paths; some broader wiring is inferred only from named modules.
